verdict.rationale: Heap is an analytics SaaS with server-side APIs, so scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys. 'Advanced user permissions' on the pricing page covers human user roles, an adjacent control that does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
